name: feature-flow
description: Clarify and capture ideas, plan feature bundles, and coordinate reviewed implementation delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Capture ideas, plan feature bundles, and coordinate reviewed implementation work.
interface.longDescription: Feature Flow provides separate Idea, Plan, and Implement skills backed by one internal clarification protocol. Idea records durable GitHub Ideas with lightweight clarification when needed; Plan converges Feature Specs, vertical implementation issues, deferred project-knowledge closeout, and internal codebase-grounded hardening; Implement coordinates isolated workers through reviewed PR-ready delivery while delegating GitHub transport to GitStack.
defaultPrompt: Use $idea to capture this proposal as a durable Idea, clarifying one material intake gap only if needed.
Use $plan to resolve material unknowns and turn this Idea into an agent-ready feature bundle with deferred knowledge closeout when needed.
Use $implement to coordinate delivery of a Feature Spec.
